RECYCLING
Clinton County Drop-off locations accept recyclables separated in the following categories:
Cardboard & Boxboard Office Paper Newspaper & Magazines
(Dry-food boxes, paper bags, egg cartons, & rolls) (Junk mail & envelopes) (Inserts, telephone books, & catalogs)
Plastic #1 Plastic #2 Aluminum & Steel Cans Glass Bottles & Jars
(PETE) (HDPE) (Empty cans) (Empty food & beverage bottles & jars)
UNACCEPTABLE MATERIALS
PLEASE NOTE: Scrap metal is ONLY accepted at Clinton County Landfill, Mooers Transfer Station, Chazy and Lyon Mountain Drop-off locations.
•Contained Gaseous Waste •Hazardous Waste •Medical Waste •Radioactive Waste
•Dead Animals •Infectious Waste •Mercury Containing Waste •Scrap Metal
•Explosives •Liquid Waste •Pesticides & Chemicals
ELECTRONIC WASTE RECYCLING
Please note: Electronic waste is ONLY accepted at Clinton County Landfill & Mooers Transfer Station
Items Accepted for Free Small Charged Items Large Charged Items
All televisions, computers, computer monitors Telephones of any kind, can openers, Large printers, large speakers,
and peripherals, small electronic equipment (such calculators, LED or tube lights, portable radios, stationary sound systems
as video games or DVD players), small scale small speakers, and vacuum cleaners
servers, and small home printers
